name: phi4-clinical
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from microsoft/Phi-4-mini-instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of microsoft/Phi-4-mini-instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 3.836 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-10-05. Evidence caveat: the only base-vs-this comparison on the card scores the base at 4-bit against a merged bf16 model, on a 50-question PubMedQA slice; the card's other table (49.0% PubMedQA, 53.0% MedQA on n=100) prints no base column at all.

benchmarks.name: PubMedQA accuracy (50-task slice)
benchmarks.config: Card 'Benchmark Results (PubMedQA)' table: 'Phi-4-mini Clinical (Merged)' 40.0% (20/50) vs 'Base Phi-4-mini (4-bit)' 26.0% (13/50). CAVEAT: base scored at 4-bit against a merged bf16 model, n=50, latency 0.93s vs 1.02s. A separate 'Verified Medical Benchmark Results' table gives 49.0% PubMedQA and 53.0% MedQA on 100 samples with no base column at all, so it cannot be used here.
